dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: I don't get it. Don't those two leaders sit in the same office — in fact, don't they sit at adjoining tables? Why are their views different?

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: It might be a communication issue...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: And every time I try to get a signature, if they aren't both missing, then one will ask me to get a second opinion from the other. I mean, would it kill them to get their story straight first!?

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Then maybe they don't have a good relationship...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: Also, more and more people are growing dissatisfied with the Palais's inaction regarding the "prophecy." One of the construction teams has even gone on strike...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: I mean, prophecies can't really be verified — we've got more practical problems to deal with!

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's true...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: I don't get it. Don't those two leaders sit in the same office — in fact, don't they sit at adjoining tables? Why are their views different?

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: It might be a communication issue...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: And every time I try to get a signature, if they aren't both missing, then one will ask me to get a second opinion from the other. I mean, would it kill them to get their story straight first!?

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Then maybe they don't have a good relationship...

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: There's been a lot of work to do regarding rebuilding and repairing the flood damage lately.

dialogues.speaker: Jacquetta
dialogues.text: The excitement of not having been dissolved didn't last long, and now a pile of other problems have surfaced that need to be dealt with...

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Yeah, that's true...

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Some problems might have been fated to be intractable... I suspect we've all got to make our own choices.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: You seem a little down.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Heh... I'm not sure I'd say that, but at the same time, it's been a while since I last considered myself happy.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: I'm an auditor here at the Palais. My work is confidential, so I can't really unburden myself of my complaints to anyone.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Of course, I fully intend to follow the rules, but sometimes I really do wish I had someone to talk to.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Maybe I need to take a different approach — learn to live with those things that don't go smoothly.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Best of luck to you.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: And to you.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry that I couldn't help.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: No, it's okay. It is good enough to chat under such a serene night sky. Thank you.

dialogues.speaker: Isadora
dialogues.text: Good night and sweet dreams.
